All runs are real `go test` executions against the reproduction module (`go 1.26.5`, stdlib only, `/tmp/forgejo-fix-demo`).

| # | Scenario | Command | Result |
|---|----------|---------|--------|
| 1 | **CI simulation** (dead port) | `FORGEJO_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1 go test ./... -v -run Forgejo` | `--- SKIP: TestForgejoE2ERepos` / `--- SKIP: TestForgejoE2EIssues` with message *"live Forgejo unreachable at http://127.0.0.1:1 (CI has no Forgejo; …): dial tcp 127.0.0.1:1: connect: connection refused"* → **PASS, exit 0** |
| 2 | **Edge case: unrelated service on the port** (found live in this env: `127.0.0.1:3000` returns `404 {"error":"Route GET /api/v1/version not found"}`) | `go test ./... -v -run Forgejo` | Both tests **SKIP** with *"version probe … returned HTTP 404; expected 2xx from a healthy Forgejo"* → **exit 0** (a probe-only guard would have wrongly FAILED here — hardened to non-2xx ⇒ skip) |
| 3 | **Live instance** (fake Forgejo serving `/api/v1/version` → 200) | `FORGEJO_URL=http://127.0.0.1:34567 go test ./... -v -run Forgejo` | Both tests **RUN and PASS**: *"ran against live instance at http://127.0.0.1:34567"* → proves reachable ⇒ suite proceeds, guard is permissive not crippling |
| 4 | **Inverted `-short` guard preserved** | `go test ./... -short -v -run Forgejo` | Both tests **PASS** with empty bodies (early return); foreman gate without `-short` still runs E2E |
| 5 | **EvalCap fix** | `go test ./... -v -run 'EvalCap\|JudgeCompaction'` | `TestEvalCapDeferral` PASS (old config ⇒ `TokenBudget:-1`; fixed ⇒ `TokenBudget:128000`); `TestJudgeCompactionDivergesWithOldConfig` PASS — old config diverges, watchdog after 100001 rounds (**the compaction loop**); `TestJudgeCompactionConvergesWithFix` PASS — `max_iterations:-1` converges in 20 rounds |
| 6 | **Full suite, CI simulation** | `FORGEJO_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1 go test ./...` | **exit 0** (all SKIP/PASS) — green CI with no Forgejo |

**Edge cases tested**: dead port (connection refused) → skip; live-but-unrelated service (HTTP 404 probe) → skip; healthy live instance → run; `-short` → early return; non-2xx (5xx/unhealthy) → skip; full-suite exit code is 0 when Forgejo is absent.

**Verification method**: `TestJudgeCompactionConvergesWithFix` / `TestJudgeCompactionDivergesWithOldConfig` assert the *contract* — with the old config the compaction loop cannot converge (watchdog), with `max_iterations:-1` it converges deterministically — plus `TestEvalCapDeferral` pins the cap semantics (`-1` ⇒ defer to section caps).
